params.name: declaration
params.description: 创作声明；搜狐要求必选

steps.expression: (() => { const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('label.el-radio')].find((l) => (l.textContent || '').trim() === '{{declaration}}'); const input = label && label.querySelector('input.el-radio__original'); if (!label || !input) throw new Error('创作声明选项不存在: {{declaration}}'); input.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', { bubbles: true })); input.click(); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('label.el-radio')].find((l) => (l.textContent || '').trim() === '{{declaration}}'); const input = label && label.querySelector('input.el-radio__original'); if (!input || !(input.checked || (label.className || '').includes('is-checked'))) throw new Error('创作声明未选中'); return true; })()
